ORION - CERTIFICATE INSTALLATION (do this ONCE, before installing Orion)
Developer: Dr. L. Hulijeli

The certificate "Orion-Certificate.cer" lets Windows recognise the Orion
installer as coming from the developer. It contains a PUBLIC key only - it
cannot run code or change anything except marking this publisher as trusted.

STEPS
1. Double-click "Orion-Certificate.cer".
   (If it was zipped, right-click the zip > Extract All first.)
2. Click "Install Certificate...".
3. Choose "Local Machine" > Next > allow the administrator prompt (Yes).
4. Choose "Place all certificates in the following store" > Browse...
5. Select "Trusted People" (or "Trusted Root Certification Authorities") > OK.
6. Next > Finish. You should see "The import was successful."

THEN
7. Double-click "Orion-v3.0.msix" and click Install.

ALTERNATIVE (no certificate needed)
Run the portable "Orion-v3.0.exe" directly. Windows SmartScreen may show a
blue warning: click "More info" > "Run anyway".

NOTE
Version 3.0 stops working after 31 December 2026.
Contact Dr. L. Hulijeli for permissions or a renewed version.
